neural_model: Eon lumped LIF plus estimated graded photoreceptor/L1/L2 compartments; not complete cellular physiology

thermoreception.status: Estimated opponent phasic receptor dynamics: VP2 heating and aristal VP3a cooling; basal firing and all constants are hypotheses, not behavior-fitted
thermoreception.missing: Per-cell calibration, VP3b non-aristal/slow pathway, sacculus humidity/cooling, internal thermosensors and damage/nociception

proprioception.polarity_status: Circuit-consistent hypothesis from MANC Figure 59, NOT a measured per-cell functional assignment; no behavior-driven choice
proprioception.kinematic_status: Actual femur-tibia angle and its causal time derivative approximate FeCO deformation; no reconstructed arculum/tendon transfer
proprioception.tuning_status: Published population position/movement features with estimated firing-rate/filter constants; individual goniotopy, hysteresis and club tonotopy unresolved

vision.status: Estimated broadband ray optics, lumped phototransduction and graded release; constants are hypotheses, not behavior-fitted or validated retinal physiology
vision.missing: Measured corneal registration, spectral/UV/polarization sensitivity, acceptance-angle integration, adaptation, receptor-specific currents, R8 cotransmission, graded dynamics of other optic-lobe types

motor_capacity: Equal capacity shares among named motor neurons of each represented muscle target; estimated, not fiber-specific innervation
joint_range_status: Estimated mechanical range around the supplied initial pose, not an action target or a measured physiological range
unmapped_motor_policy: Retain neuron in the CNS and report its spikes, but do not invent a peripheral force target
unmapped_sensory_policy: Retain neuron in the CNS; no fabricated sensory input
limitations: Incomplete peripheral muscle and receptor coverage; not a complete digital animal.
Muscle force, kinetics, geometry transfer and motor-unit capacity are estimates.
No behavior policy, gait, target joint angle, approach score or direct walking stimulation.
Unknown transmitter physiology, neuromodulation and electrical synapses remain unresolved.
